notes.title: Update 0.9
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed calculation of Space Gambler event options' conditions, now you can only gamble the money you actually have!
- Fixed achievement "You sure you gonna win that back?", now it assigns the achievement correctly
- Hopefully fixed an issue causing units to sometimes stop interacting under really specific conditions
[h3]Features[/h3]
- Added achievement "Cheater!" for using hacking device to cheat the Space Gambler

notes.title: Small update 0.8
notes.content: [h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed friendly error caused by corrupted my generation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed loot dropping from queen, now she drops Alien Heart like she should have[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed inventory UI panel that was really hard to drag around the screen[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.7
notes.content: [h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed game pooping itself when you kill your own soldier[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed friendly error appearing when killed creature hits another with the bullet it shot while it was alive[/p][/*][/list][h3]Features[/h3][list][*][p]Added warning while trying to leave while the federation is on a station and you have not yet dealt with them[/p][/*][/list][h3]Balancing[/h3][list][*][p]Removed the terminal from the elevator room (it was causing soft locks).[/p][/*][*][p]Added elevator to spawn in medbays and offices.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced hacking time from 10 seconds (wtf?) to 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Terminals are now destructible and dismantlable  [/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the time needed to loot small and big power cells[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced amount of enemies needed to be killed to complete the victory condition "Kill Federation Soldiers" from 100% of initially spawned to 75% of initially spawned[/p][/*][/list][h3]Misc[/h3][list][*][p]Added creature count per team to the debug panel accessible by pressing F6 [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.5
notes.content: [h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Audio of Mr. Bonson's attacks has now properly adjusted volume according to audio settings[/p][/*][*][p]Patched some friendly errors[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed HOLK achievement not registering[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed HOLK serum having wrong ID causing the localization to not display the name and the description properly[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.4
notes.content: [h3]Features[/h3][list][*][p]Added error console that will open the log location for you, as well as instructions what to do when you encounter one![/p][list][*][p]I would want to in the end have some type of server, so you can send the log file with a simple button press. But I'm a little scared of hardcoding an address to a server running on my RassberyPI, so I will have to look into some type of secure way of receiving them, maybe discord hooks?[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed reload progress bar to yellow to indicate the interaction is reloading, and nothing else[/p][/*][*][p]Hopefully fixed the localization not loading for Linux[/p][/*][*][p]Made the ammo UI fade away instead of suddenly disappearing[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Infinite reloading glitch caused by upgraded ammo capacity[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed player crew to get suck on props when ordering them to go to unreachable places[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed creature pathing through 2 diagonal props[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.3
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed "Apply Upgrade" button being interactable when you already have crew (ship) upgrade of this type.
- Fixed units not reloading when idling
- Fixed medkits having interaction that DOES NOTHING

[h2]Balancing[/h2]
- Disabled zombie boomers spawning in the first sector
- Added a weapon trade station in the initial location
- Decreased amount of enemies spawning

[h2]Features[/h2]
- Changes in main menu
- Added links to socials
- Added current ammo display
- Added edge panning for camera
- Added small shadow to the font so its more readable

[h2]Misc[/h2]
- Added new cheat commands

notes.title: The Hive Update

notes.title: Update: New boss location, new federation enemy, new faction, world gen
notes.content: [list][*][p]Changed world generation, [/p][list][*][p]regions will have from 1 to 3 shops,[/p][/*][*][p]the amount of event locations is now random as well, but on average reduced[/p][/*][*][p]first region now will always have less locations[/p][/*][*][p]first region instead of being Zombie themed, now is "mixed", with aliens and zombies[/p][/*][*][p]Now there are 6 regions per game[/p][list][*][p]Starting Location[/p][/*][*][p]Aliens - Bloodspawn / Zombies - Megatron[/p][/*][*][p]Aliens - Queen / Zombies - Killerbot[/p][/*][*][p]Aliens - Queen / Zombies - HULK Laboratory[/p][/*][*][p]Federation Zone[/p][/*][*][p]F.M.S Zone[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added new boss location[/p][list][*][p]Bandit Hideout is a new boss location in the starting region[/p][/*][*][p]It does not contain a boss per se, but one of the rooms is a "Bandit Stash" which contains multiple big boxes, weapon cabinet as well as a new special bandit box, which will contain upgrader module.[/p][/*][*][p]Bandit Hideout is filled with two new units[/p][list][*][p]Bandit Melee[/p][/*][*][p]Bandit Gunner[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added French localization[/p][/*][*][p]Intro now is disabled[/p][/*][*][p]Added new localization keys[/p][/*][*][p]New federation enemy: "Marauder", special enemy attacking using a mini-grenade launcher[/p][/*][*][p]New Item: mini-grenade launcher, only obtainable by killing Marauders[/p][/*][*][p]Now Marauders spawn in the 4th region[/p][/*][*][p]Marauders have been added to the F.M.S.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update: balance changes, ship upgrades
notes.content: [p]- balance changes, nerf to all regeneration items[/p][p]- reduced health for the alien queen[/p][p]- increased attack speed of alien queen by 12%[/p][p]- you can only access upgrader in shop nodes[/p][p]- added new trader specializing in ship upgrades[/p][p]- added ship upgrades, [/p][p]   upgrader - allows accessing upgrader outside of shops[/p][p]   enemy counter - shows count of enemies on the map[/p][p]   fuel pumps - gives 33% chance to not use fuel on travel[/p][p]   juice pumps - decrease juice usage by 25%.[/p][p]   advanced flashlights - increase crew vision by 25%[/p][p]- ship upgrades can provide additional options for events[/p][p]- enemy manage gathering changes -> decreased mana growth, increased base mana income[/p][p]- federation soldier buff -> +33% damage, 1 more HP, decreased speed by 14%[/p][p]- from regions 3+ federation stations will also spawn Special OPS[/p][p]- increased XP of Special OPS[/p][p]- decreased attack speed of rifle by 25%, decreased damage of rifle by 20%[/p][p]- increased cost of a flamethrower[/p][p]- decreased pushback of shotgun[/p][p]- decreased pushback of sniper rifle[/p][p]- general nerf to energy sword[/p][p]- decreased armor efficiency[/p][p]- general nerf to "defense" of melee weapons[/p][p][/p]
